item.title: Building the OLIMAT Treviso Website
item.description:
I was asked to build a website for OLIMAT Treviso, the Treviso district of the Italian Math Olympiad.

It was a project I was happy to work on for reasons that go a little beyond building the website itself. I participated in math competitions when I was in high school, and the Liceo Scientifico Leonardo da Vinci (my former high school) is also the school referenced by the project as the hub for the Treviso district.
